items.details: Take the supplied cargo vehicle and watch its special damage meter, not only whether it is still moving. Brake early at junctions and use wider streets so a small navigation mistake does not become repeated collisions. Keep the required vehicle until the delivery confirms success. Follow any subsequent message before assuming the entire assignment is over. This is a vehicle-preservation problem; a fast traffic car cannot substitute for the cargo vehicle.

details_i18n.en: Take the supplied cargo vehicle and watch its special damage meter, not only whether it is still moving. Brake early at junctions and use wider streets so a small navigation mistake does not become repeated collisions. Keep the required vehicle until the delivery confirms success. Follow any subsequent message before assuming the entire assignment is over. This is a vehicle-preservation problem; a fast traffic car cannot substitute for the cargo vehicle.
details_i18n.pt: Pegue o veículo de carga fornecido e acompanhe seu medidor especial de dano, não apenas se ele ainda anda. Freie cedo nos cruzamentos e use vias largas para evitar que um erro de navegação vire colisões repetidas. Preserve o veículo exigido até confirmar a entrega. Leia qualquer mensagem seguinte antes de presumir que o trabalho inteiro acabou. O desafio é preservar o veículo; um carro rápido do trânsito não substitui o transporte da carga.

items.details: Take Jonnie's car to the indicated bomb-shop contact, then drive to the marked parking area. Car bombs have two stages in this GBA game: select the bomb and arm it inside the car, then exit, move clear and use the detonator. Do not try to trigger it while still seated. After the explosion, clear the wanted level and return to Jonnie as instructed; destroying the target alone does not finish the operation.

details_i18n.en: Take Jonnie's car to the indicated bomb-shop contact, then drive to the marked parking area. Car bombs have two stages in this GBA game: select the bomb and arm it inside the car, then exit, move clear and use the detonator. Do not try to trigger it while still seated. After the explosion, clear the wanted level and return to Jonnie as instructed; destroying the target alone does not finish the operation.
details_i18n.pt: Leve o carro de Jonnie ao contato indicado da oficina de bombas e depois à área marcada de estacionamento. As bombas de carro têm duas etapas neste jogo de GBA: selecione e arme a bomba dentro do carro; depois desça, afaste-se e use o detonador. Não tente acioná-la ainda sentado. Após a explosão, despiste a polícia e volte a Jonnie conforme a instrução; destruir o alvo sozinho não conclui a operação.

items.details: Recover the requested Rocket Launcher, then deal with the attackers using your other weapons or a vehicle. The launcher is the item you must preserve for delivery: firing it during this job causes mission failure. Defeat the marked attackers and return to Jonnie with the requested equipment intact. Do not mistake the newly collected weapon for permission to use it in the ambush.

details_i18n.en: Recover the requested Rocket Launcher, then deal with the attackers using your other weapons or a vehicle. The launcher is the item you must preserve for delivery: firing it during this job causes mission failure. Defeat the marked attackers and return to Jonnie with the requested equipment intact. Do not mistake the newly collected weapon for permission to use it in the ambush.
details_i18n.pt: Recolha o Rocket Launcher solicitado e enfrente os atacantes com outras armas ou um veículo. O lançador é o item que precisa ser preservado para a entrega: dispará-lo durante esse trabalho causa falha. Derrote os atacantes marcados e volte a Jonnie com o equipamento intacto. Encontrar a nova arma não significa que você deva usá-la na emboscada.

description_i18n.en: Find the marked subject and follow the changing instructions.

items.details: Reach the marked limousine before the timer expires and damage it until the politician gets out. Keep the target alive: use fists to pressure him, while dealing separately with guards and police. Shooting the politician fails the mission, so check your selected weapon before approaching him. After the conversation confirms success, lose the wanted level before returning to Jonnie. Returning while still wanted can fail the job even after the persuasion is complete.

details_i18n.en: Reach the marked limousine before the timer expires and damage it until the politician gets out. Keep the target alive: use fists to pressure him, while dealing separately with guards and police. Shooting the politician fails the mission, so check your selected weapon before approaching him. After the conversation confirms success, lose the wanted level before returning to Jonnie. Returning while still wanted can fail the job even after the persuasion is complete.
details_i18n.pt: Alcance a limusine marcada antes de acabar o prazo e danifique-a até o político sair. Mantenha o alvo vivo: use os punhos para pressioná-lo e lide separadamente com os guardas e a polícia. Atirar no político causa falha; confira a arma selecionada antes de se aproximar. Depois que o diálogo confirmar o sucesso, elimine a perseguição antes de voltar a Jonnie. Retornar ainda procurado pode causar falha mesmo após a persuasão.

items.details: Intercept the marked vehicle and pressure its driver until the ID card drops, then collect it. Before approaching the factory, make sure a car bomb is available; visit the bomb shop if you have none. Take the prepared car into the marked position, arm the device, get out and move beyond the blast. Exit the compound afterward until the mission confirms success. Reaching the entrance with the card but no explosive is not enough to complete the demolition stage.

details_i18n.en: Intercept the marked vehicle and pressure its driver until the ID card drops, then collect it. Before approaching the factory, make sure a car bomb is available; visit the bomb shop if you have none. Take the prepared car into the marked position, arm the device, get out and move beyond the blast. Exit the compound afterward until the mission confirms success. Reaching the entrance with the card but no explosive is not enough to complete the demolition stage.
details_i18n.pt: Intercepte o veículo marcado e pressione o motorista até ele soltar o cartão de identificação; recolha-o. Antes de se aproximar da fábrica, confirme que tem uma bomba de carro; visite a oficina de bombas se não tiver. Leve o carro preparado à posição marcada, arme o dispositivo, desça e saia do alcance da explosão. Depois deixe o pátio até a missão confirmar o sucesso. Chegar à entrada com o cartão, mas sem explosivo, não basta para concluir a demolição.

items.description: Complete the rescue and protect the return journey.

description_i18n.en: Complete the rescue and protect the return journey.

items.details: Follow the information payment and then approach the locked rescue vehicle. The marked guards provide the missing key: defeat them until the key drops and collect it before returning to the vehicle. You do not need to continue fighting every unrelated guard after the access objective is satisfied. The escape vehicle is a bus, so slow down for tight corners and avoid tipping it over. Confirm the passenger is aboard and prioritize the marked return over chasing pursuing cars.

details_i18n.en: Follow the information payment and then approach the locked rescue vehicle. The marked guards provide the missing key: defeat them until the key drops and collect it before returning to the vehicle. You do not need to continue fighting every unrelated guard after the access objective is satisfied. The escape vehicle is a bus, so slow down for tight corners and avoid tipping it over. Confirm the passenger is aboard and prioritize the marked return over chasing pursuing cars.
details_i18n.pt: Siga o pagamento pela informação e aproxime-se do veículo de resgate trancado. Os guardas marcados fornecem a chave que falta: enfrente-os até ela cair e recolha-a antes de voltar ao veículo. Não é preciso continuar combatendo todo guarda sem relação após cumprir o objetivo de acesso. O transporte de fuga é um ônibus; reduza nas curvas fechadas e evite capotá-lo. Confirme o embarque da passageira e priorize o retorno marcado, sem perseguir os carros inimigos.

items.details: There are several marked trucks and a shared mission limit. Stop a truck, damage it enough to make the driver emerge and read the resulting conversation before moving on. Do not indiscriminately kill every driver: the mission's instructions require questioning and recovering the correct transport. When a driver yields, stop attacking and let the conversation complete. After identifying the right truck, board it with the required passenger and return to Asuka before the timer expires.

details_i18n.en: There are several marked trucks and a shared mission limit. Stop a truck, damage it enough to make the driver emerge and read the resulting conversation before moving on. Do not indiscriminately kill every driver: the mission's instructions require questioning and recovering the correct transport. When a driver yields, stop attacking and let the conversation complete. After identifying the right truck, board it with the required passenger and return to Asuka before the timer expires.
details_i18n.pt: Há vários caminhões marcados e um prazo compartilhado da missão. Pare um caminhão, cause dano suficiente para o motorista sair e leia a conversa antes de seguir ao próximo. Não mate indiscriminadamente todos os motoristas: as instruções exigem interrogatório e recuperação do transporte correto. Quando um deles ceder, pare de atacar e deixe a conversa terminar. Após identificar o caminhão certo, entre com o passageiro exigido e volte a Asuka antes de o tempo acabar.

items.title: Complete Assault Joint
items.description: Prepare for the extended compound confrontation.

description_i18n.en: Prepare for the extended compound confrontation.
description_i18n.pt: Prepare-se para o confronto prolongado no pátio.

items.details: Prepare weapons, armor and health before starting: the next escape mission begins automatically afterward. Clear the initial attackers and reach Asuka's marked position. At the short waiting prompt, allowing the countdown to finish brings supporting gunfire instead of forcing you to rush alone through the entrance. The boss confrontation continues through repeated stages, so keep cover and preserve ammunition for the final timed phase. Finish the marked boss and the required surrounding enemies rather than assuming the first depleted health bar ends the fight.

details_i18n.en: Prepare weapons, armor and health before starting: the next escape mission begins automatically afterward. Clear the initial attackers and reach Asuka's marked position. At the short waiting prompt, allowing the countdown to finish brings supporting gunfire instead of forcing you to rush alone through the entrance. The boss confrontation continues through repeated stages, so keep cover and preserve ammunition for the final timed phase. Finish the marked boss and the required surrounding enemies rather than assuming the first depleted health bar ends the fight.
details_i18n.pt: Prepare armas, colete e saúde antes de começar: a missão de fuga seguinte começa automaticamente depois. Resolva os atacantes iniciais e alcance a posição marcada de Asuka. Na breve espera indicada, deixar a contagem terminar traz fogo de apoio em vez de obrigar você a avançar sozinho pela entrada. O confronto com o chefe passa por etapas repetidas; use cobertura e preserve munição para a fase final cronometrada. Resolva o chefe marcado e os inimigos próximos exigidos, sem presumir que esvaziar a primeira barra de saúde encerra a luta.

items.details: This finale starts automatically after Assault Joint. You have five minutes to reach the airport aircraft while under maximum police pressure. Use the available vehicle to leave the compound and focus on the marked destination rather than attempting to eliminate every pursuer. Plan broad turns and avoid trapping a damaged vehicle against roadblocks. Reaching the plane completes the story; use the offered save-game choice to preserve the completed state before choosing to quit into the credits.

details_i18n.pt: Este final começa automaticamente após Assault Joint. Você tem cinco minutos para alcançar o avião no aeroporto sob pressão policial máxima. Use o veículo disponível para sair do pátio e concentre-se no destino marcado, sem tentar eliminar todos os perseguidores. Planeje curvas amplas e evite prender um veículo danificado nos bloqueios. Alcançar o avião conclui a história; use a opção de salvar oferecida para preservar o estado concluído antes de escolher sair para os créditos.

items.title: Win Portland Race 1
items.description: Complete this island course successfully; guide numbering also identifies it as Race 1 overall.

description_i18n.en: Complete this island course successfully; guide numbering also identifies it as Race 1 overall.

items.details: Read each course's rules before accelerating. Advance races include both ordered checkpoint routes and courses that let you collect markers in a chosen order; some also add interfering vehicles. For ordered routes, brake before the turn so the marker is not missed. For open-order routes, choose a sweep that avoids crossing the island repeatedly. A controllable vehicle and a clean route are often more useful than raw top speed on the GBA's tight streets. Repeat the course until its success is recorded.

details_i18n.en: Read each course's rules before accelerating. Advance races include both ordered checkpoint routes and courses that let you collect markers in a chosen order; some also add interfering vehicles. For ordered routes, brake before the turn so the marker is not missed. For open-order routes, choose a sweep that avoids crossing the island repeatedly. A controllable vehicle and a clean route are often more useful than raw top speed on the GBA's tight streets. Repeat the course until its success is recorded.
details_i18n.pt: Leia as regras de cada percurso antes de acelerar. As corridas de Advance incluem rotas de checkpoints ordenados e percursos que permitem escolher a ordem das marcações; algumas também têm veículos atrapalhando. Nas rotas ordenadas, freie antes da curva para não perder o ponto. Nas de ordem livre, escolha um trajeto que evite atravessar a ilha repetidamente. Um veículo controlável e uma rota limpa costumam ajudar mais que velocidade máxima nas ruas apertadas de GBA. Repita até registrar o sucesso.

items.details: GBA Paramedic is not GTA III's three-patient system. Collect every patient spawned for the current level before returning to the hospital; the ambulance can carry the entire group. Cleared levels persist, so a later attempt resumes after the highest cleared level rather than forcing levels one through twelve in one sitting. Damage is not repaired automatically between levels, and the ambulance cannot use the respray. Start service work with L+R; press R first so L does not make you exit the vehicle by itself.

details_i18n.en: GBA Paramedic is not GTA III's three-patient system. Collect every patient spawned for the current level before returning to the hospital; the ambulance can carry the entire group. Cleared levels persist, so a later attempt resumes after the highest cleared level rather than forcing levels one through twelve in one sitting. Damage is not repaired automatically between levels, and the ambulance cannot use the respray. Start service work with L+R; press R first so L does not make you exit the vehicle by itself.
details_i18n.pt: Paramedic de GBA não usa o sistema de três pacientes de GTA III. Recolha todos os pacientes gerados no nível atual antes de voltar ao hospital; a ambulância leva o grupo inteiro. Os níveis concluídos permanecem registrados, então uma tentativa posterior retoma após o maior nível concluído, sem exigir do um ao doze de uma vez. O dano não é reparado automaticamente entre níveis, e a ambulância não usa a oficina de pintura. Inicie o serviço com L+R; aperte R primeiro para L não fazer você sair sozinho do veículo.

items.title: Complete Demolition Football
items.description: Unlock the Staunton stadium activity and pass all four stages.

description_i18n.en: Unlock the Staunton stadium activity and pass all four stages.
description_i18n.pt: Libere a atividade do estádio de Staunton e passe nas quatro etapas.

items.details: Complete all six Staunton races to unlock the football-shaped activity marker in the island's northwest. The event uses Banshees and a ramp to meet four different landing-distance targets; it is not an ordinary football match. Adjust the run-up to the current requested distance rather than using maximum speed for every stage. A landed car catches fire whether the jump succeeds or fails, so exit and move away immediately. Complete the fourth successful stage for the required activity completion.

details_i18n.en: Complete all six Staunton races to unlock the football-shaped activity marker in the island's northwest. The event uses Banshees and a ramp to meet four different landing-distance targets; it is not an ordinary football match. Adjust the run-up to the current requested distance rather than using maximum speed for every stage. A landed car catches fire whether the jump succeeds or fails, so exit and move away immediately. Complete the fourth successful stage for the required activity completion.
details_i18n.pt: Conclua as seis corridas de Staunton para liberar a marcação em forma de futebol americano no noroeste da ilha. O evento usa Banshees e uma rampa para atingir quatro distâncias diferentes de aterrissagem; não é uma partida comum de futebol. Ajuste a arrancada à distância pedida, sem usar velocidade máxima em toda etapa. O carro pega fogo ao pousar, com sucesso ou falha; desça e afaste-se imediatamente. Conclua a quarta etapa com sucesso para registrar a atividade exigida.
